# ⭕ Tic-Tac-Toe

**A two-player Tic-Tac-Toe game for the terminal, written in Java**

![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-ED8B00?style=flat-square&logo=openjdk&logoColor=white)
![Console app](https://img.shields.io/badge/Console%20app-4b5563?style=flat-square&logo=gnometerminal&logoColor=white)

</div>

## 🎬 Demo

https://github.com/mayankksingh5/Tic-Tac-Toe_game/assets/87350832/92d9c7f4-3cde-4f6f-b06f-bc2597970e4e

## ✨ Features

- 👥 Two players take turns as **X** and **O**
- 🗺️ The 3×3 board is redrawn after every move
- 🚫 Invalid or occupied cells are rejected
- 🏆 Detects a win or a tie automatically

## 🎮 How to play

Enter your move as a row and a column from 1 to 3, separated by a space. For example, `1 2` is the first row, second column.

## 🚀 Run locally

```bash
git clone https://github.com/mayankksingh5/Tic-Tac-Toe_game.git
cd Tic-Tac-Toe_game
javac TicTacToe.java
java TicTacToe
```
